summary: Buyer Dashboard Fase 2 testing complete. All 17 features verified working correctly. 5 tabs (Dashboard, Seguimiento, Recomendados, Alertas, Perfil) fully functional. Match reasons displayed on recommended deals. Backend API returns match_reason field. All UI components working as expected.

backend: /api/matching/deals returns match_reason field with Spanish text (e.g., 'Encaja con tu sector de interés')

KPI renamed from 'DEALS EN MERCADO' to 'DEALS DISPONIBLES'
Free plan overlay is subtle (not invasive): 'Acceso limitado en plan Free · Ver planes' inside process cards
Seguimiento tab shows saved/bookmarked deals with sector (Media / Social), financials (2.5M, 450K), saved date (23/3/2026)
Recomendados tab shows deals with affinity badges ('Alta afinidad') and match_reason text
Match reasons explain WHY: 'Encaja con tu sector de interés', 'Coincide con el rango de facturación que buscas'
Alertas tab shows notifications list (currently empty) with read/unread status support
Alertas tab shows notification preferences (Email, In-app channels) for 3 notification types
Alertas has 'MARCAR TODO LEÍDO' button when notifications exist (not shown when empty)
Perfil tab shows personal data: DATOS PERSONALES (Nombre, Email, Empresa, Cargo)
Perfil tab shows investment thesis: TESIS DE INVERSIÓN (Tipo de buyer, Ticket objetivo, Sectores de interés, Geografía, Tipo de operación)
Perfil tab shows verification checklist: VERIFICACIÓN (Email verificado ✓, Perfil completo ✓, Empresa declarada ✗, Tesis de inversión ✗)
Perfil has 'EDITAR PERFIL DE COMPRADOR' CTA button
Tab navigation works: switching between 5 tabs updates content correctly
Unread notification count badge on Alertas tab (shows when unread_count > 0)
Right rail persists across all tabs: plan status (FREE) + market (9 deals activos) + quick links
